# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Device Lock

Determines when the screen locks and which requirements apply to the passcode, plus the behaviour on closing the lid and power.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0 — SC - Device Security - U - Power and Device Lock |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Device_Lock.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Device_Lock.json) |

> OIB calls this policy U because it assigns it to users; all 12 settings are device-scoped, so here it is D (see check-scope.js). The three own password settings remain. Since OIB v4.0 this also contains the lock after 15 minutes of inactivity (interactivelogon_machineinactivitylimit_v2 = 900): the replacement for the discontinued Password compliance policy, and a setting the baseline previously set in Local Security Policies. Sleep on AC power goes to 30 minutes along with it, so that locking and sleeping do not happen at the same moment.
